armyRules.name: Voice of Command
armyRules.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

rule.name: Ruthless Discipline
rule.text:

While an **^^Astra Militarum^^** unit from your army is affected by an Order, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re‑roll a Hit roll of 1.

Snap to It.effect: Your unit’s OFFICER model can issue 1 Order as if it were your Command phase.

rule.name: Artillery Support
rule.text:
At the start of the battle round, select one of the following types of artillery support.

- **Creeping Barrage:** Roll one D6 for each enemy unit that is more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield: On a 5+, until the end of the battle round, that unit is shaken. While a unit is shaken, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it. The maximum number of units that can be shaken by this rule in each battle round depends on the battle size, as shown below.

- **Incendiary Bombardment:** Select a number of enemy units more than 12" from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are scattered. While a unit is scattered, it cannot have the Benefit of Cover. The maximum number of units you can select this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.

- **Smoke Shells:** Select a number of units from your army. Until the end of the battle round, those units have the Stealth ability. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.

**Battle Size - Maximum Number of Units**
Incursion - 2
Strike Force - 3
Onslaught - 4

rule.name: Stealth
rule.text: If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the **benefit of cover** against that attack (13.08).

Trench Fighters.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if it is a REGIMENT model. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One INFANTRY OFFICER unit from your army embarked within a TRANSPORT. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it is embarked within a TRANSPORT.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can issue Orders even though it is not on the battlefield, and it can issue Orders to ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT units from your army [excluding TITANIC units) regardless of the distance to and from your unit’s TRANSPORT.
Vox-Relay.flavour: This armoured transport has been modified to house a tactical command suite and vox-relay, enabling embarked officers to give orders from relative safety.

Rapid Dispersal.name: RAPID DISPERSAL
Rapid Dispersal.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this phase.
Rapid Dispersal.effect: Your INFANTRY unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
Rapid Dispersal.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this phase.

EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
Rapid Dispersal.flavour: Troops trained in mechanised combat disembark swiftly from their transport’s hatches, avoiding incoming fire and advancing on their objectives.

Clear and Secure.name: CLEAR AND SECURE
Clear and Secure.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Clear and Secure.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Clear and Secure.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Clear and Secure.flavour: Mechanised charges rely upon shock, awe and speed to secure ground. Any enemies that block the path must be obliterated swiftly.

Swift Interception.name: SWIFT INTERCEPTION
Swift Interception.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Swift Interception.target: One TRANSPORT unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT and TITANIC units) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
Swift Interception.effect: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Swift Interception.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One TRANSPORT unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT and TITANIC units) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.

EFFECT: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Swift Interception.flavour: Fast-moving armoured transports allow a commander to react quickly to enemy movements and intercept outflanking opponents.

Hasty Extraction.name: HASTY EXTRACTION
Hasty Extraction.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, after an enemy unit has selected targets for its charge but before it makes a Charge move.
Hasty Extraction.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
Hasty Extraction.effect: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.
Hasty Extraction.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, after an enemy unit has selected targets for its charge but before it makes a Charge move.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.

EFFECT: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.
Hasty Extraction.flavour: Should the tide turn against them, mechanised forces swiftly re-embark their transports in order to reposition.

Move Out.name: MOVE OUT
Move Out.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army.
Move Out.effect: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.
Move Out.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s turn.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army.

EFFECT: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.
Move Out.flavour: High command’s priorities have shifted. Swift embarkation and redeployment is required.

enhancements.name: - Bold Leadership
enhancements.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. If you control an objective marker at the end of your Command phase, and the bearer's unit (or any **^^Transport^^** it is embarked within) is within range of that objective marker, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

enhancements.name: - Sacred Unguents
enhancements.text: **^^Astra Militarum Tech-Priest Enginseer^^** model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one **^^Transport^^** from your army (excluding **^^Aircraft^^** and **^^Titanic^^** units) within 3" of the bearer. Until the end of the phase, each time that **^^Transport^^** makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: - Smoke Grenades
enhancements.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. The bearer's unit has the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability while the bearer's unit is wholly within 3" of one or more friendly **^^Transport^^** models.

enhancements.name: - Vanguard Honours
enhancements.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. The bearer's unit can disembark from a **^^Transport^^** after it has Advanced. If it does, it counts as having made a Normal move that phase, and cannot declare a charge in the same turn, but can otherwise act normally in the remainder of the turn.

rule.name: Masters of Camouflage
rule.text: Friendly **ASTRA MILITARUM** units (excluding **TITANIC** units) have **Stealth**.

Crack Shots.name: CRACK SHOTS
Crack Shots.target: One PLATOON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Crack Shots.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
Crack Shots.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One PLATOON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
Crack Shots.flavour: Reconnaissance units are often comprised of experienced survivalists and hunters, many of whom are expert marksmen.

Draw Them Out.name: DRAW THEM OUT
Draw Them Out.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Draw Them Out.target: One PLATOON unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit, and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Draw Them Out.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Draw Them Out.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One PLATOON unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit, and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Draw Them Out.flavour: Light infantry utilise harassing fire to draw their enemies into position for an ambush.

Scramble Field.name: SCRAMBLE FIELD
Scramble Field.when: Start of your opponent’s Reinforcements step.
Scramble Field.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army.
Scramble Field.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of your unit.
Scramble Field.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of your unit.
Scramble Field.flavour: This unit is equipped with a scramble field generator, a device capable of disrupting teleportation beacons and other homing technology.

Courageous Diversion.name: COURAGEOUS DIVERSION
Courageous Diversion.when: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.
Courageous Diversion.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY or ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED unit from your army.
Courageous Diversion.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and each time an enemy model makes an attack, if your unit is the closest eligible target, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Courageous Diversion.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY or ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and each time an enemy model makes an attack, if your unit is the closest eligible target, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Courageous Diversion.flavour: These soldiers scream blood-curdling battle cries as they rush forwards, emboldening their squadmates and causing the enemy to waver.

Tanglefoot Grenades.name: TANGLEFOOT GRENADES
Tanglefoot Grenades.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Tanglefoot Grenades.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM GRENADES unit from your army.
Tanglefoot Grenades.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
Tanglefoot Grenades.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM GRENADES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
Tanglefoot Grenades.flavour: Employed by skirmishers and recon troops, tanglefoot grenades ensnare advancing infantry, slowing their advance.

Scouting Outriders.name: SCOUTING OUTRIDERS
Scouting Outriders.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED or ASTRA MILITARUM WALKER unit from your army that is wholly within 10" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Scouting Outriders.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Scouting Outriders.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s turn.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED or ASTRA MILITARUM WALKER unit from your army that is wholly within 10" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Scouting Outriders.flavour: Sentinels and cavalry units use their speed and mobility to outflank the foe, ready to strike at the most opportune moment.

enhancements.name: - Guerrilla Honours
enhancements.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. After both players have deployed their armies, if the bearer is on the battlefield, select up to three other **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: - Scare Gas Grenades
enhancements.text: **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** model only. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one enemy unit within 8" of the bearer's unit (excluding **^^Monster^^** and **^^Vehicle^^** units); that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: - Survival Gear
enhancements.text: **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** model only. The bearer has the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: - Tripwires
enhancements.text: **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** model only. Each time an enemy **^^Infantry^^** or **^^Mounted^^** unit ends a Normal, Advance, Charge, or Fall Back move within 8" of the bearer's unit, roll a D6; on a 4+, until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is stunned. While a unit is stunned, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

rule.name: Squadron Command
rule.text: Add **^^Squadron^^** to the list of units each **^^Officer^^** unit from your army can issue Orders to. Add the Order below to those listed in the Voice of Command ability.

rule.name: Keywords
rule.text: **^^Astra Militarum Squadron^^** units from your army have the **^^Armoured Skirmisher^^** keyword (excluding **^^Artillery^^** units and units containing one or more models with a Wounds characteristic of 13 or higher).

rule.name: On My Signal
rule.text: This Order can only be issued to **^^Armoured Skirmisher^^** units. Each time an enemy unit ends a Normal or Advance move within 8" of this unit, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". Each unit can only move in this way once per turn.

Order the Advance.name: ORDER THE ADVANCE
Order the Advance.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.
Order the Advance.effect: Select one or more friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6" of your unit; until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for those units.
Order the Advance.text:
WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one or more friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6" of your unit; until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for those units.
Order the Advance.flavour: At a barked order, armour and infantry surge forward as one, utilising speed and aggression to close with objectives and the enemy.

Mobile Firebase.name: MOBILE FIREBASE
Mobile Firebase.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army Advances or Falls Back.
Mobile Firebase.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
Mobile Firebase.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army Advances or Falls Back.

TARGET: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
Mobile Firebase.flavour: Armoured fighting vehicles and transports keep pace with the infantry, supporting the advance as mobile gun platforms

Burst of Speed.name: BURST OF SPEED
Burst of Speed.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that did not Remain Stationary or arrive from Reserves this phase.
Burst of Speed.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
Burst of Speed.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that did not Remain Stationary or arrive from Reserves this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
Burst of Speed.flavour: Pushing bodies or engines to the limit, these warriors continue their swift advance.

Supporting Ordnance.name: SUPPORTING ORDNANCE
Supporting Ordnance.target: One ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Supporting Ordnance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Supporting Ordnance.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Supporting Ordnance.flavour: This vehicle’s heavy weapons support lightly equipped infantry, suppressing enemy armour and bringing down lumbering monsters.

Combined Fire.name: COMBINED FIRE
Combined Fire.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army has shot.
Combined Fire.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover, and each time an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 2.
Combined Fire.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover, and each time an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 2.
Combined Fire.flavour: Hammering the enemy, this transport’s crew share targeting solutions with nearby allies, allowing for concentrated combined fire to obliterate the foe’s infantry and even erode armour plating.

Opening Salvo.name: OPENING SALVO
Opening Salvo.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Opening Salvo.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Opening Salvo.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Opening Salvo.flavour: Emerging from their armoured transports, heavily armed soldiers open fire before enemies can dive for cover or angle their stoutest armour towards the fusillade.

enhancements.name: - Exemplary Officer
enhancements.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. Each time the bearer issues an Order to its own unit, you can select up to two other **^^Platoon^^** units within 3" of the bearer’s unit. That Order is also issued to each of those units.

enhancements.name: - Master Manoeuvrist
enhancements.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in that unit is within 3" of an **^^Astra Militarum Transport^^** from your army, it can embark within that **^^Transport^^**.

enhancements.name: - Omnissian Unguents (Aura)
enhancements.text: **^^Astra Militarum Tech‑Priest Enginseer^^** model only. While a friendly **^^Armoured Skirmisher^^** unit is within 3" of the bearer, that unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: - Grand Strategist
enhancements.text: **^^Officer^^** model only. In your Command phase, the bearer can issue one additional Order.

rule.name: Born Soldiers
rule.text:
Each time a model in a **^^Regiment^^** unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible unit (excluding **^^Monsters^^** and **^^Vehicles^^**) that attack has the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability.

Each time a model in a **^^Squadron^^** unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible **^^Monster^^** or **^^Vehicle^^** unit, that attack has the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability.

rule.name: Lethal Hits
rule.text:
Each time an attack made with a **[LETHAL HITS]** weapon results in a **critical hit**, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target. 
***Designer’s Note:** Choosing to automatically wound the target means that no **wound roll** is made for that attack. You may decide against this, as it means that attack cannot result in a **critical wound** and so cannot trigger other abilities such as [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].*

Coordinated Action.name: COORDINATED ACTION
Coordinated Action.target: One REGIMENT unit from your army and one SQUADRON unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit.
Coordinated Action.effect: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.
Coordinated Action.text:
WHEN: Start of any phase.

TARGET: One REGIMENT unit from your army and one SQUADRON unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.
Coordinated Action.flavour: The potency of armour and infantry is greatly enhanced when both work in close concert.

Reinforcements!.name: REINFORCEMENTS!
Reinforcements!.target: One INFANTRY REGIMENT unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
Reinforcements!.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining.
Reinforcements!.restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
Reinforcements!.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One INFANTRY REGIMENT unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining.

RESTRICTIONS: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
Reinforcements!.flavour: So numerous are the infantry of the Astra Militarum that fresh reserves can be called up at a moment’s notice.

Flexible Command.name: FLEXIBLE COMMAND
Flexible Command.target: Any number of ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER units from your army.
Flexible Command.effect: Until the end of the phase, your Officers can issue Orders to REGIMENT units and SQUADRON units.
Flexible Command.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: Any number of ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER units from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your Officers can issue Orders to REGIMENT units and SQUADRON units.
Flexible Command.flavour: Some Astra Militarum officers have served with infantry and armour, and are equally adept at commanding either.

Fields of Fire.name: FIELDS OF FIRE
Fields of Fire.target: One REGIMENT unit and one SQUADRON unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
Fields of Fire.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your selected REGIMENT and SQUADRON units make an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Fields of Fire.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One REGIMENT unit and one SQUADRON unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your selected REGIMENT and SQUADRON units make an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Fields of Fire.flavour: Armour and infantry work in concert, forming overlapping fields of fire against which neither cover nor heavy armour can protect.

Inspired Command.name: INSPIRED COMMAND
Inspired Command.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.
Inspired Command.effect: Your OFFICER can issue one Order as if it were your Command phase.
Inspired Command.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Command phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.

EFFECT: Your OFFICER can issue one Order as if it were your Command phase.
Inspired Command.flavour: The greatest officers make their voices heard at the critical moment, their orders swift and decisive.

Stalwart Protector.name: STALWART PROTECTOR
Stalwart Protector.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Stalwart Protector.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army.
Stalwart Protector.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack is allocated to an INFANTRY model from your army, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of your VEHICLE, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.
Stalwart Protector.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack is allocated to an INFANTRY model from your army, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of your VEHICLE, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.
Stalwart Protector.flavour: The indefatigable tanks of the Astra Militarum serve as mobile cover for the troops marching in their shadow.

enhancements.name: - Death Mask of Ollanius
enhancements.text: **^^Officer^^** model only. While the bearer’s unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, instead of changing it to 0

enhancements.name: - Drill Commander
enhancements.text: **^^Officer^^** model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, if that unit Remained Stationary this turn, a Critical Hit is scored on a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

enhancements.name: - Grand Strategist
enhancements.text: **^^Officer^^** model only. In your Command phase, the bearer can issue one additional Order.

enhancements.name: - Reactive Command
enhancements.text: **^^Officer^^** model only. Each time an enemy unit is set up within 8" of the bearer's unit, the bearer can issue one Order. This is not counted towards the number of Orders the bearer can issue each battle round.

rule.name: Fire Zone Purge
rule.text:
- If a friendly **MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER** model is your **WARLORD**, friendly **TEMPESTUS SCIONS** units have:
-- **BATTLELINE**.
-- +1 **OC**.
- When a friendly **MILITARUM TEMPESTUS** unit is **selected to shoot**, if that unit was set up this turn, that unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to **hit rolls**.

On My Position.name: ON MY POSITION
On My Position.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
On My Position.effect:
Roll one D6 for each enemy unit engaged with your unit:

- On a 2+ that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

Then, your unit suffers 3D3 mortal wounds.
On My Position.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly engaged REGIMENT unit.

EFFECT: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit engaged with your unit:

- On a 2+ that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

Then, your unit suffers 3D3 mortal wounds.
On My Position.flavour: Circling Aeronautica Imperialis strike fighters wait above to launch strafing runs should the attack falter. In extremis, these assets can be called down upon Imperial positions in danger of being overrun, affording soldiers the desperate dignity of taking their enemies with them into death.

Firing Hot.name: FIRING HOT
Firing Hot.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS/KASRKIN unit is selected to shoot.
Firing Hot.effect: Your unit’s Hot-shot Lascarbines, Hot-shot Lasguns, Hot-shot Laspistols, Hot-shot Marksman Rifles, Hot-shot Volley Guns and Sentry Hot-shot Volley Guns weapons that targeted an enemy unit within 12" have +1 S and AP.
Firing Hot.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS/KASRKIN unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That MILITARUM TEMPESTUS/KASRKIN unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Hot-shot Lascarbines, Hot-shot Lasguns, Hot-shot Laspistols, Hot-shot Marksman Rifles, Hot-shot Volley Guns and Sentry Hot-shot Volley Guns weapons that targeted an enemy unit within 12" have +1 S and AP.
Firing Hot.flavour: At the risk of permanently burning out power packs, hot-shot weaponry can be temporarily overcharged to provide additional punch at the crucial moment.

Servo-Designators.name: SERVO‑DESIGNATORS
Servo-Designators.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit has shot.
Servo-Designators.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. Friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS units’ ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].
Servo-Designators.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit has shot.

TARGET: That MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. Friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS units’ ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].
Servo-Designators.flavour: Released in a swarm from a modified Valkyrie gunship, high-altitude servo-skulls analyse targeting data from the ongoing fight and then provide updated firing solutions to the troops on the ground.

enhancements.name: - Bombast-class Vox-array
enhancements.text: **MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER** model only. When this model issues an **Order**, if this unit has the **Master Vox** wargear ability, this model can issue that **Order** to up to three different **REGIMENT** units, instead of only one.

enhancements.name: - Priority drop Beacon
enhancements.text: **MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER** model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an **ingress move**.

rule.name: Designated Targets
rule.text:
Friendly **SCOUT SENTINEL/ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE** units have the Signal Flares ability.

This **detachment** has the **RECON** tag and cannot be taken with another **RECON detachment**.

rule.name: Signal Flares
rule.text:
In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one **visible** enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is **designated**:
▪ While a unit is **designated**, that unit has +3" **detection range**.

Close-Range Detection.name: CLOSE-RANGE DETECTION
Close-Range Detection.target: One friendly SCOUT SENTINEL/ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
Close-Range Detection.effect: While a visible enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that unit has +3" detection range.
Close-Range Detection.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly SCOUT SENTINEL/ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: While a visible enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that unit has +3" detection range.
Close-Range Detection.flavour: With a daring reconnaissance dangerously close to the hiding enemy, soldiers can provide more accurate reports of their location.

Triggered Alerts.name: TRIGGERED ALERTS
Triggered Alerts.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
Triggered Alerts.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3"
Triggered Alerts.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.

TARGET: That ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3"
Triggered Alerts.flavour: Alerted by proximity snares set up by recon teams, readied soldiers can evade their prowling foes to prepare new firing lines.

Sump-Smog Screen.name: SUMP-SMOG SCREEN
Sump-Smog Screen.when: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase
Sump-Smog Screen.target: One friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE unit.
Sump-Smog Screen.effect: When an attack targets either your unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.
Sump-Smog Screen.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase

TARGET: One friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE unit.

EFFECT: When an attack targets either your unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.
Sump-Smog Screen.flavour: Named for the density and reek of their concealing smoke, varied packs of foul chemicals are carried by elite scouts that can be ignited to foul the enemy’s aim.

enhancements.name: - Long-Range ScoutUPGRADE
enhancements.text: SCOUT SENTINEL unit only. This unit has Infiltrators

enhancements.name: - Recon StarUPGRADE
enhancements.text: ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY PLATOON unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

rule.name: Absolutist Principles
rule.text:
Friendly **BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD/RATLINGS** units have **ABHUMAN**.
- Friendly **COMMISSAR** models can:
-- Issue the Take Aim! Order.
-- Issue 1 Order to a friendly **ABHUMAN** unit.
This **detachment** has the **ABHUMAN** tag and cannot be taken with another **ABHUMAN detachment**.

Thick-Skulled Obdurance.name: THICK-SKULLED OBDURANCE
Thick-Skulled Obdurance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit that is within range of an objective.
Thick-Skulled Obdurance.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
Thick-Skulled Obdurance.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit that is within range of an objective.

TARGET: That BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
Thick-Skulled Obdurance.flavour: With an order to hold the line, Ogryn auxilia will devotedly – and stubbornly – endure the most extreme firepower to see their duty done.

Low Profile.name: LOW PROFILE
Low Profile.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RATLINGS unit has shot.
Low Profile.effect: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.
Low Profile.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RATLINGS unit has shot.

TARGET: That RATLINGS unit.

EFFECT: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.
Low Profile.flavour: Ratling snipers carefully scout out the most advantageous vantage points from which to unleash their kill shots, positions in which their eerie stillness and diminutive silhouette are hard to spot.

Stirred to Action.name: STIRRED TO ACTION
Stirred to Action.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit has shot.
Stirred to Action.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
Stirred to Action.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit has shot.

TARGET: That BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
Stirred to Action.flavour: An enemy who manages to pierce the Ogryns’ dense forms often succeeds only in attracting their attention and becoming the objects of a sudden and trampling rush.

enhancements.name: - Sharp eyes, Light fingersUPGRADE
enhancements.text: RATLINGS unit only. When this unit is selected to shoot, enemy units have +6" detection range until this unit has shot.

enhancements.name: - Exemplar of DutyUPGRADE
enhancements.text:
LEADER: BULLGRYN SQUAD, OGRYN SQUAD

COMMISSAR model only. This model has Feel No Pain 4+.

rule.name: Direct Orders
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Voice of Command ability retain that ability and gain this one.

Each time an OFFICER model in this unit issues an Order, that Order can be issued to any one friendly ASTRA MILITARUM unit within range, regardless of any keywords that unit is normally required to have.

rule.name: Get Down!
rule.text: Each time an ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army is selected to shoot, you can select one other friendly ASTRA MILITARUM unit (excluding OGRYN units). Until the end of the phase, models in the attacking unit can ignore models in that friendly unit for the purposes of determining visibility.

Against the Odds.name: AGAINST THE ODDS
Against the Odds.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Against the Odds.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (excluding OGRYN units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Against the Odds.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2.
Against the Odds.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (excluding OGRYN units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2.
Against the Odds.flavour: Imperial Guardsmen faced by nightmarish foes in the close quarters of a boarding action may be driven to fight as never before to survive.

Duck and Cover.name: DUCK AND COVER
Duck and Cover.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Duck and Cover.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (excluding OGRYN units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and has one or more models on the opposite side of an open Hatchway from one or more models in the attacking unit.
Duck and Cover.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Duck and Cover.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (excluding OGRYN units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and has one or more models on the opposite side of an open Hatchway from one or more models in the attacking unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Duck and Cover.flavour: Between training and the Human instinct for self-preservation, these soldiers manage to make the most of the available cover.

Idle Hands.name: IDLE HANDS
Idle Hands.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Idle Hands.effect: Select one closed Hatchway within 1" of your unit. Your unit can operate that Hatchway.
Idle Hands.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot operate a Hatchway again.
Idle Hands.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one closed Hatchway within 1" of your unit. Your unit can operate that Hatchway.

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot operate a Hatchway again.
Idle Hands.flavour: Spending a long time stuck in one section of a voidship leads bored soldiers to explore their surroundings and discover useful shortcuts in case of emergency.

Brutal Choke Point.name: BRUTAL CHOKE POINT
Brutal Choke Point.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.
Brutal Choke Point.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (excluding OGRYN units) that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
Brutal Choke Point.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
Brutal Choke Point.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (excluding OGRYN units) that has not fired Overwatch this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
Brutal Choke Point.flavour: The Tactica Imperialis teaches well how to exploit choke points to slaughter the foe. Its lessons transfer well to voidship corridors and chambers.

enhancements.name: Rigged Blind Grenades
enhancements.text: Once per battle, when an enemy unit opens a Hatchway, if the bearer is on the battlefield, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit is Battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Shipboard Veteran
enhancements.text: Each time you target an **^^Astra Militarum^^** unit from your army with a Stratagem, if that unit is visible to the bearer, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

rule.name: Direct Orders
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Voice of Command ability retain that ability and gain this one.

Each time an OFFICER model in this unit issues an Order, that Order can be issued to any one friendly ASTRA MILITARUM unit within range, regardless of any keywords that unit is normally required to have.

rule.name: Purge-Sweep Protocols
rule.text: Each time a MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit from your army is selected to shoot, if one or more models in that unit are within 1" of an open Hatchway and every model in that unit is on the same side of that Hatchway, select one enemy unit on the opposite side of that Hatchway from that unit. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HiTS] ability while targeting that enemy unit.

Brutal Training.name: BRUTAL TRAINING
Brutal Training.target: One MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Brutal Training.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Brutal Training.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Brutal Training.flavour: Tempestus Scions are trained in a range of specialist hand-to-hand combat techniques. Coupled with combat stimms, these make them bruising foes.

Coordinated Strike.name: COORDINATED STRIKE
Coordinated Strike.target: One OFFICER model from your army.
Coordinated Strike.effect: Select one Order your model can issue. Every ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army is issued that Order (regardless of any keywords those units are normally required to have).
Coordinated Strike.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, OFFICER models from your army cannot issue Orders. You can only use this Stratagem once.
Coordinated Strike.text:
WHEN: Start of your Command phase.

TARGET: One OFFICER model from your army.

EFFECT: Select one Order your model can issue. Every ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army is issued that Order (regardless of any keywords those units are normally required to have).

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, OFFICER models from your army cannot issue Orders. You can only use this Stratagem once.
Coordinated Strike.flavour: Employing coordinated helm chronos, the Scions execute a pre-arranged simultaneous tactical manoeuvre.

Lockdown.name: LOCKDOWN
Lockdown.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Lockdown.effect: Until the end of the phase, after your unit ends a move, you can select one open Hatchway it moved through during that move; close that Hatchway.
Lockdown.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, after your unit ends a move, you can select one open Hatchway it moved through during that move; close that Hatchway.
Lockdown.flavour: Voidborne Scions are trained to swiftly goad the machine spirits of bulkheads and hatches, slamming them shut in their wake to trap the foe.

Fire-Pattern Hurricanus.name: FIRE-PATTERN HURRICANUS
Fire-Pattern Hurricanus.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit from your army has shot.
Fire-Pattern Hurricanus.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, subtract 2 from the Move characteristic of models in that enemy unit, and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.
Fire-Pattern Hurricanus.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, subtract 2 from the Move characteristic of models in that enemy unit, and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.
Fire-Pattern Hurricanus.flavour: Emptying the magazines of their weapons in an indiscriminate hail of fire, the Scions create a zone of lethality that foes will struggle to advance into.

enhancements.name: Covert Breach
enhancements.text: At the start of the first battle round, the bearer's unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

enhancements.name: Elimination Force
enhancements.text: At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than the Toughness characteristic of that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

coordinatedaction.name: COORDINATED ACTION
coordinatedaction.target: One REGIMENT unit from your army and one SQUADRON unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit.
coordinatedaction.effect: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.
coordinatedaction.text:
WHEN: Start of any phase.

TARGET: One REGIMENT unit from your army and one SQUADRON unit from your army within 6" of and visible to that REGIMENT unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, Orders affecting one of your units affect the other, and vice versa.
coordinatedaction.flavour: The potency of armour and infantry is greatly enhanced when both work in close concert.

reinforcements.name: REINFORCEMENTS!
reinforcements.target: One INFANTRY REGIMENT unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
reinforcements.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining.
reinforcements.restrictions: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
reinforcements.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One INFANTRY REGIMENT unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining.

RESTRICTIONS: This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.
reinforcements.flavour: So numerous are the infantry of the Astra Militarum that fresh reserves can be called up at a moment’s notice.

flexiblecommand.name: FLEXIBLE COMMAND
flexiblecommand.target: Any number of ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER units from your army.
flexiblecommand.effect: Until the end of the phase, your Officers can issue Orders to REGIMENT units and SQUADRON units.
flexiblecommand.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: Any number of ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER units from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your Officers can issue Orders to REGIMENT units and SQUADRON units.
flexiblecommand.flavour: Some Astra Militarum officers have served with infantry and armour, and are equally adept at commanding either.

fieldsoffire.name: FIELDS OF FIRE
fieldsoffire.target: One REGIMENT unit and one SQUADRON unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
fieldsoffire.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your selected REGIMENT and SQUADRON units make an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
fieldsoffire.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One REGIMENT unit and one SQUADRON unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time your selected REGIMENT and SQUADRON units make an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
fieldsoffire.flavour: Armour and infantry work in concert, forming overlapping fields of fire against which neither cover nor heavy armour can protect.

inspiredcommand.name: INSPIRED COMMAND
inspiredcommand.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.
inspiredcommand.effect: Your OFFICER can issue one Order as if it were your Command phase.
inspiredcommand.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Command phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.

EFFECT: Your OFFICER can issue one Order as if it were your Command phase.
inspiredcommand.flavour: The greatest officers make their voices heard at the critical moment, their orders swift and decisive.

stalwartprotector.name: STALWART PROTECTOR
stalwartprotector.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stalwartprotector.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army.
stalwartprotector.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack is allocated to an INFANTRY model from your army, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of your VEHICLE, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.
stalwartprotector.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack is allocated to an INFANTRY model from your army, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of your VEHICLE, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.
stalwartprotector.flavour: The indefatigable tanks of the Astra Militarum serve as mobile cover for the troops marching in their shadow.

trenchfighters.name: TRENCH FIGHTERS
trenchfighters.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
trenchfighters.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
trenchfighters.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if it is a REGIMENT model. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
trenchfighters.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if it is a REGIMENT model. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
trenchfighters.flavour: Inured to the savage horrors of trench warfare, these warriors will fight until their last breath.

overthetop.name: OVER THE TOP
overthetop.target: One INFANTRY OFFICER model from your army.
overthetop.effect: Until the end of the phase, when your model issues the Move! Move! Move! Order, it can issue that Order to any number of eligible friendly INFANTRY REGIMENT units, regardless of range to your model.
overthetop.text:
WHEN: Start of your Command phase.

TARGET: One INFANTRY OFFICER model from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when your model issues the Move! Move! Move! Order, it can issue that Order to any number of eligible friendly INFANTRY REGIMENT units, regardless of range to your model.
overthetop.flavour: The whistle blows to signal the attack. Waves of infantry emerge from cover to advance upon the foe.

flareburst.name: FLARE BURST
flareburst.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
flareburst.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit within 12", you can re-roll the Hit roll.
flareburst.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit within 12", you can re-roll the Hit roll.
flareburst.flavour: As the infantry assault proceeds, flares are fired into the skies, illuminating opponents below.

calloussacrifice.name: CALLOUS SACRIFICE
calloussacrifice.target: One PLATOON unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
calloussacrifice.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, one model from your unit is destroyed after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
calloussacrifice.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One PLATOON unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, one model from your unit is destroyed after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.
calloussacrifice.flavour: All victory requires sacrifice. The destruction of the enemy must always take priority over the preservation of lives.

furiousfusillade.name: FURIOUS FUSILLADE
furiousfusillade.target: One PLATOON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
furiousfusillade.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit while targeting an enemy unit within half range.
furiousfusillade.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One PLATOON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit while targeting an enemy unit within half range.
furiousfusillade.flavour: Whilst accuracy has its benefits, sheer weight of fire is no less effective at bringing down the foe.

minefield.name: MINEFIELD
minefield.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
minefield.target: One PLATOON unit from your army.
minefield.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6 for each model in that enemy unit: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
minefield.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One PLATOON unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6 for each model in that enemy unit: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
minefield.flavour: Sappers have laid down a network of mines across the battlefield. Should the enemy attempt an ill-advised assault, they will surely suffer for it.

voxrelay.name: VOX-RELAY
voxrelay.target: One INFANTRY OFFICER unit from your army embarked within a TRANSPORT. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it is embarked within a TRANSPORT.
voxrelay.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can issue Orders even though it is not on the battlefield, and it can issue Orders to ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT units from your army [excluding TITANIC units) regardless of the distance to and from your unit’s TRANSPORT.
voxrelay.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One INFANTRY OFFICER unit from your army embarked within a TRANSPORT. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it is embarked within a TRANSPORT.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can issue Orders even though it is not on the battlefield, and it can issue Orders to ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT units from your army [excluding TITANIC units) regardless of the distance to and from your unit’s TRANSPORT.
voxrelay.flavour: This armoured transport has been modified to house a tactical command suite and vox-relay, enabling embarked officers to give orders from relative safety.

rapiddispersal.name: RAPID DISPERSAL
rapiddispersal.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this phase.
rapiddispersal.effect: Your INFANTRY unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
rapiddispersal.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this phase.

EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
rapiddispersal.flavour: Troops trained in mechanised combat disembark swiftly from their transport’s hatches, avoiding incoming fire and advancing on their objectives.

clearandsecure.name: CLEAR AND SECURE
clearandsecure.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
clearandsecure.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
clearandsecure.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
clearandsecure.flavour: Mechanised charges rely upon shock, awe and speed to secure ground. Any enemies that block the path must be obliterated swiftly.

swiftinterception.name: SWIFT INTERCEPTION
swiftinterception.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
swiftinterception.target: One TRANSPORT unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT and TITANIC units) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
swiftinterception.effect: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".
swiftinterception.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One TRANSPORT unit from your army (excluding AIRCRAFT and TITANIC units) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.

EFFECT: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".
swiftinterception.flavour: Fast-moving armoured transports allow a commander to react quickly to enemy movements and intercept outflanking opponents.

hastyextraction.name: HASTY EXTRACTION
hastyextraction.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, after an enemy unit has selected targets for its charge but before it makes a Charge move.
hastyextraction.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
hastyextraction.effect: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.
hastyextraction.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, after an enemy unit has selected targets for its charge but before it makes a Charge move.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.

EFFECT: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.
hastyextraction.flavour: Should the tide turn against them, mechanised forces swiftly re-embark their transports in order to reposition.

moveout.name: MOVE OUT
moveout.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army.
moveout.effect: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.
moveout.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s turn.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army.

EFFECT: Provided your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in your unit is within 3" of an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.
moveout.flavour: High command’s priorities have shifted. Swift embarkation and redeployment is required.

finalhour.name: FINAL HOUR
finalhour.target: One SQUADRON unit from your army that is Below Half-strength (excluding OFFICER units).
finalhour.effect: Until the end of the battle round, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons) have the [HAZARDOUS] ability, and each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and to the Hit roll.
finalhour.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One SQUADRON unit from your army that is Below Half-strength (excluding OFFICER units).

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle round, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons) have the [HAZARDOUS] ability, and each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and to the Hit roll.
finalhour.flavour: Even with flames licking through the interior of their vehicle, this crew refuse to abandon their positions, regardless of the risk to their lives.

blazingadvance.name: BLAZING ADVANCE
blazingadvance.when: Your Movement phase, just after a SQUADRON unit from your army Advances.
blazingadvance.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.
blazingadvance.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a SQUADRON unit from your army Advances.

TARGET: That SQUADRON unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.
blazingadvance.flavour: By petitioning the machine spirits of their vehicles, tank crews push their armoured steeds beyond conventional limits.

tacticalwithdrawal.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
tacticalwithdrawal.when: Your Movement phase, just after a SQUADRON unit from your army Falls Back.
tacticalwithdrawal.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
tacticalwithdrawal.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a SQUADRON unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That SQUADRON unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
tacticalwithdrawal.flavour: Even in retreat, the armoured fist of the Astra Militarum keep their cannons firing.

crashthrough.name: CRASH THROUGH
crashthrough.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
crashthrough.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
crashthrough.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.
crashthrough.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.
crashthrough.flavour: Ruins, barricades, bunkers; few such structures can impede the grinding advance of an Astra Militarum armoured corps.

furiouscannonade.name: FURIOUS CANNONADE
furiouscannonade.target: One SQUADRON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
furiouscannonade.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
furiouscannonade.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One SQUADRON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
furiouscannonade.flavour: At close range, armoured vehicles open up with their full complement of weapons, dispensing the Emperor’s righteous wrath.

ablativeplating.name: ABLATIVE PLATING
ablativeplating.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
ablativeplating.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
ablativeplating.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
ablativeplating.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
ablativeplating.flavour: Crews routinely reinforce their vehicle's armour, adding ablative plating, track links, sandbags and other means to protect the hull.

crackshots.name: CRACK SHOTS
crackshots.target: One PLATOON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
crackshots.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
crackshots.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One PLATOON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
crackshots.flavour: Reconnaissance units are often comprised of experienced survivalists and hunters, many of whom are expert marksmen.

drawthemout.name: DRAW THEM OUT
drawthemout.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
drawthemout.target: One PLATOON unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit, and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
drawthemout.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
drawthemout.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One PLATOON unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit, and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
drawthemout.flavour: Light infantry utilise harassing fire to draw their enemies into position for an ambush.

scramblefield.name: SCRAMBLE FIELD
scramblefield.when: Start of your opponent’s Reinforcements step.
scramblefield.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army.
scramblefield.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of your unit.
scramblefield.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of your unit.
scramblefield.flavour: This unit is equipped with a scramble field generator, a device capable of disrupting teleportation beacons and other homing technology.

courageousdiversion.name: COURAGEOUS DIVERSION
courageousdiversion.when: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.
courageousdiversion.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY or ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED unit from your army.
courageousdiversion.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and each time an enemy model makes an attack, if your unit is the closest eligible target, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
courageousdiversion.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY or ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and each time an enemy model makes an attack, if your unit is the closest eligible target, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
courageousdiversion.flavour: These soldiers scream blood-curdling battle cries as they rush forwards, emboldening their squadmates and causing the enemy to waver.

tanglefootgrenades.name: TANGLEFOOT GRENADES
tanglefootgrenades.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
tanglefootgrenades.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM GRENADES unit from your army.
tanglefootgrenades.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
tanglefootgrenades.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM GRENADES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
tanglefootgrenades.flavour: Employed by skirmishers and recon troops, tanglefoot grenades ensnare advancing infantry, slowing their advance.

scoutingoutriders.name: SCOUTING OUTRIDERS
scoutingoutriders.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED or ASTRA MILITARUM WALKER unit from your army that is wholly within 10" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
scoutingoutriders.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
scoutingoutriders.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s turn.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED or ASTRA MILITARUM WALKER unit from your army that is wholly within 10" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
scoutingoutriders.flavour: Sentinels and cavalry units use their speed and mobility to outflank the foe, ready to strike at the most opportune moment.

snaptoit.name: SNAP TO IT
snaptoit.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.
snaptoit.effect: Your unit’s OFFICER model can issue 1 Order as if it were your Command phase.
snaptoit.text:
WHEN: Start of any phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.

EFFECT: Your unit’s OFFICER model can issue 1 Order as if it were your Command phase.
snaptoit.flavour: Reading the flow of battle and reacting in accordance, this officer expects their barked orders to be followed post-haste.

noretreat.name: NO RETREAT!
noretreat.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by the Duty and Honour! Order.
noretreat.effect: If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a phase.
noretreat.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by the Duty and Honour! Order.

EFFECT: If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a phase.
noretreat.flavour: Battle-hardened and zealous, the company’s grizzled elites will gladly give their lives to honour the Emperor.

veteransharpshooters.name: VETERAN SHARPSHOOTERS
veteransharpshooters.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
veteransharpshooters.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
veteransharpshooters.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
veteransharpshooters.flavour: Marksmanship is a skill that only increases with experience.

purgingfire.name: PURGING FIRE
purgingfire.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by an Order that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
purgingfire.effect: If your unit is within range of an objective marker, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
purgingfire.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army affected by an Order that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: If your unit is within range of an objective marker, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
purgingfire.flavour: Clear the area and defend your objectives. Take no prisoners.

mordianminute.name: MORDIAN MINUTE
mordianminute.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army affected by the First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! Order.
mordianminute.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1.
mordianminute.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit from your army affected by the First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! Order.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1.
mordianminute.flavour: Named for the soldiers of Mordian, this rapid-fire drill requires exceptional accuracy and coordination, but renders even the humble lasgun highly lethal.

additionalarmour.name: ADDITIONAL ARMOUR
additionalarmour.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
additionalarmour.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
additionalarmour.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
additionalarmour.text:
