WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
additionalarmour.flavour: Veteran soldiers know the value of additional protection, whether welded to vehicles or worn under flak armour.

engineofwrath.name: ENGINE OF WRATH
engineofwrath.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
engineofwrath.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 2, and each time a model in your unit fights, it can only target that enemy unit.
engineofwrath.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 6 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 2, and each time a model in your unit fights, it can only target that enemy unit.
engineofwrath.flavour: An unstoppable engine of destruction, this super-heavy tank thunders forward, crushing enemies to bloody pulp beneath its steel treads.

imposingarrival.name: IMPOSING ARRIVAL
imposingarrival.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, from the second battle round onwards.
imposingarrival.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit from your army that is in Reserves.
imposingarrival.effect: Set up your unit on the battlefield, wholly within 8" of the battlefield edge and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
imposingarrival.text:
WHEN: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, from the second battle round onwards.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit from your army that is in Reserves.

EFFECT: Set up your unit on the battlefield, wholly within 8" of the battlefield edge and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
imposingarrival.flavour: The arrival of a super-heavy tank on the battlefield can swiftly turn the tide of the fight.

adamantinebehemoth.name: ADAMANTINE BEHEMOTH
adamantinebehemoth.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
adamantinebehemoth.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
adamantinebehemoth.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
adamantinebehemoth.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
adamantinebehemoth.flavour: Barricades, trenches, bunkers and ruins: these obstacles are ground to dust by the obdurate advance of Astra Militarum armour.

shatteringsalvo.name: SHATTERING SALVO
shatteringsalvo.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit from your army has shot.
shatteringsalvo.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.
shatteringsalvo.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.
shatteringsalvo.flavour: Turrets and sponsons unleash a tempest of fury, toppling fortifications and leaving stunned and wounded enemies exposed to incoming fire.

witheringfirepower.name: WITHERING FIREPOWER
witheringfirepower.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army has shot.
witheringfirepower.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
witheringfirepower.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after an ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
witheringfirepower.flavour: Subjected to a thunderous volley of explosive shells and bullets, enemies begin to waver.

accuracyunderpressure.name: ACCURACY UNDER PRESSURE
accuracyunderpressure.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
accuracyunderpressure.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
accuracyunderpressure.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
accuracyunderpressure.flavour: Only the most disciplined soldiers and vehicle crews can maintain accuracy in the deafening confusion of an armoured clash.

ordertheadvance.name: ORDER THE ADVANCE
ordertheadvance.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.
ordertheadvance.effect: Select one or more friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6" of your unit; until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for those units.
ordertheadvance.text:
WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one or more friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6" of your unit; until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for those units.
ordertheadvance.flavour: At a barked order, armour and infantry surge forward as one, utilising speed and aggression to close with objectives and the enemy.

mobilefirebase.name: MOBILE FIREBASE
mobilefirebase.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army Advances or Falls Back.
mobilefirebase.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
mobilefirebase.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army Advances or Falls Back.

TARGET: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
mobilefirebase.flavour: Armoured fighting vehicles and transports keep pace with the infantry, supporting the advance as mobile gun platforms

burstofspeed.name: BURST OF SPEED
burstofspeed.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that did not Remain Stationary or arrive from Reserves this phase.
burstofspeed.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
burstofspeed.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that did not Remain Stationary or arrive from Reserves this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
burstofspeed.flavour: Pushing bodies or engines to the limit, these warriors continue their swift advance.

supportingordnance.name: SUPPORTING ORDNANCE
supportingordnance.target: One ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
supportingordnance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
supportingordnance.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
supportingordnance.flavour: This vehicle’s heavy weapons support lightly equipped infantry, suppressing enemy armour and bringing down lumbering monsters.

combinedfire.name: COMBINED FIRE
combinedfire.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army has shot.
combinedfire.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover, and each time an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 2.
combinedfire.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover, and each time an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 2.
combinedfire.flavour: Hammering the enemy, this transport’s crew share targeting solutions with nearby allies, allowing for concentrated combined fire to obliterate the foe’s infantry and even erode armour plating.

openingsalvo.name: OPENING SALVO
openingsalvo.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
openingsalvo.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
openingsalvo.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
openingsalvo.flavour: Emerging from their armoured transports, heavily armed soldiers open fire before enemies can dive for cover or angle their stoutest armour towards the fusillade.

thickskulledobdurance.name: THICK-SKULLED OBDURANCE
thickskulledobdurance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit that is within range of an objective.
thickskulledobdurance.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
thickskulledobdurance.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit that is within range of an objective.

TARGET: That BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
thickskulledobdurance.flavour: With an order to hold the line, Ogryn auxilia will devotedly – and stubbornly – endure the most extreme firepower to see their duty done.

lowprofile.name: LOW PROFILE
lowprofile.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RATLINGS unit has shot.
lowprofile.effect: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.
lowprofile.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RATLINGS unit has shot.

TARGET: That RATLINGS unit.

EFFECT: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.
lowprofile.flavour: Ratling snipers carefully scout out the most advantageous vantage points from which to unleash their kill shots, positions in which their eerie stillness and diminutive silhouette are hard to spot.

stirredtoaction.name: STIRRED TO ACTION
stirredtoaction.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit has shot.
stirredtoaction.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
stirredtoaction.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit has shot.

TARGET: That BULLGRYN SQUAD/OGRYN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
stirredtoaction.flavour: An enemy who manages to pierce the Ogryns’ dense forms often succeeds only in attracting their attention and becoming the objects of a sudden and trampling rush.

closerangedetection.name: CLOSE-RANGE DETECTION
closerangedetection.target: One friendly SCOUT SENTINEL/ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
closerangedetection.effect: While a visible enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that unit has +3" detection range.
closerangedetection.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly SCOUT SENTINEL/ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: While a visible enemy unit is within 6" of your unit, that unit has +3" detection range.
closerangedetection.flavour: With a daring reconnaissance dangerously close to the hiding enemy, soldiers can provide more accurate reports of their location.

triggeredalerts.name: TRIGGERED ALERTS
triggeredalerts.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.
triggeredalerts.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3"
triggeredalerts.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.

TARGET: That ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3"
triggeredalerts.flavour: Alerted by proximity snares set up by recon teams, readied soldiers can evade their prowling foes to prepare new firing lines.

sumpsmogscreen.name: SUMP-SMOG SCREEN
sumpsmogscreen.when: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase
sumpsmogscreen.target: One friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE unit.
sumpsmogscreen.effect: When an attack targets either your unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.
sumpsmogscreen.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase

TARGET: One friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE unit.

EFFECT: When an attack targets either your unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.
sumpsmogscreen.flavour: Named for the density and reek of their concealing smoke, varied packs of foul chemicals are carried by elite scouts that can be ignited to foul the enemy’s aim.

onmyposition.name: ON MY POSITION
onmyposition.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
onmyposition.effect:
Roll one D6 for each enemy unit engaged with your unit:

- On a 2+ that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

Then, your unit suffers 3D3 mortal wounds.
onmyposition.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly engaged REGIMENT unit.

EFFECT: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit engaged with your unit:

- On a 2+ that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

Then, your unit suffers 3D3 mortal wounds.
onmyposition.flavour: Circling Aeronautica Imperialis strike fighters wait above to launch strafing runs should the attack falter. In extremis, these assets can be called down upon Imperial positions in danger of being overrun, affording soldiers the desperate dignity of taking their enemies with them into death.

firinghot.name: FIRING HOT
firinghot.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS/KASRKIN unit is selected to shoot.
firinghot.effect: Your unit’s Hot-shot Lascarbines, Hot-shot Lasguns, Hot-shot Laspistols, Hot-shot Marksman Rifles, Hot-shot Volley Guns and Sentry Hot-shot Volley Guns weapons that targeted an enemy unit within 12" have +1 S and AP.
firinghot.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS/KASRKIN unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That MILITARUM TEMPESTUS/KASRKIN unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Hot-shot Lascarbines, Hot-shot Lasguns, Hot-shot Laspistols, Hot-shot Marksman Rifles, Hot-shot Volley Guns and Sentry Hot-shot Volley Guns weapons that targeted an enemy unit within 12" have +1 S and AP.
firinghot.flavour: At the risk of permanently burning out power packs, hot-shot weaponry can be temporarily overcharged to provide additional punch at the crucial moment.

servodesignators.name: SERVO‑DESIGNATORS
servodesignators.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit has shot.
servodesignators.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. Friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS units’ ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].
servodesignators.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit has shot.

TARGET: That MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. Friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS units’ ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].
servodesignators.flavour: Released in a swarm from a modified Valkyrie gunship, high-altitude servo-skulls analyse targeting data from the ongoing fight and then provide updated firing solutions to the troops on the ground.

againsttheodds.name: AGAINST THE ODDS
againsttheodds.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
againsttheodds.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (excluding OGRYN units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
againsttheodds.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2.
againsttheodds.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (excluding OGRYN units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2.
againsttheodds.flavour: Imperial Guardsmen faced by nightmarish foes in the close quarters of a boarding action may be driven to fight as never before to survive.

duckandcover.name: DUCK AND COVER
duckandcover.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
duckandcover.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (excluding OGRYN units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and has one or more models on the opposite side of an open Hatchway from one or more models in the attacking unit.
duckandcover.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
duckandcover.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (excluding OGRYN units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and has one or more models on the opposite side of an open Hatchway from one or more models in the attacking unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
duckandcover.flavour: Between training and the Human instinct for self-preservation, these soldiers manage to make the most of the available cover.

idlehands.name: IDLE HANDS
idlehands.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
idlehands.effect: Select one closed Hatchway within 1" of your unit. Your unit can operate that Hatchway.
idlehands.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot operate a Hatchway again.
idlehands.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one closed Hatchway within 1" of your unit. Your unit can operate that Hatchway.

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot operate a Hatchway again.
idlehands.flavour: Spending a long time stuck in one section of a voidship leads bored soldiers to explore their surroundings and discover useful shortcuts in case of emergency.

brutalchokepoint.name: BRUTAL CHOKE POINT
brutalchokepoint.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.
brutalchokepoint.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (excluding OGRYN units) that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
brutalchokepoint.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
brutalchokepoint.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army (excluding OGRYN units) that has not fired Overwatch this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
brutalchokepoint.flavour: The Tactica Imperialis teaches well how to exploit choke points to slaughter the foe. Its lessons transfer well to voidship corridors and chambers.

brutaltraining.name: BRUTAL TRAINING
brutaltraining.target: One MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
brutaltraining.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
brutaltraining.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
brutaltraining.flavour: Tempestus Scions are trained in a range of specialist hand-to-hand combat techniques. Coupled with combat stimms, these make them bruising foes.

coordinatedstrike.name: COORDINATED STRIKE
coordinatedstrike.target: One OFFICER model from your army.
coordinatedstrike.effect: Select one Order your model can issue. Every ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army is issued that Order (regardless of any keywords those units are normally required to have).
coordinatedstrike.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, OFFICER models from your army cannot issue Orders. You can only use this Stratagem once.
coordinatedstrike.text:
WHEN: Start of your Command phase.

TARGET: One OFFICER model from your army.

EFFECT: Select one Order your model can issue. Every ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army is issued that Order (regardless of any keywords those units are normally required to have).

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, OFFICER models from your army cannot issue Orders. You can only use this Stratagem once.
coordinatedstrike.flavour: Employing coordinated helm chronos, the Scions execute a pre-arranged simultaneous tactical manoeuvre.

lockdown.name: LOCKDOWN
lockdown.target: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
lockdown.effect: Until the end of the phase, after your unit ends a move, you can select one open Hatchway it moved through during that move; close that Hatchway.
lockdown.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, after your unit ends a move, you can select one open Hatchway it moved through during that move; close that Hatchway.
lockdown.flavour: Voidborne Scions are trained to swiftly goad the machine spirits of bulkheads and hatches, slamming them shut in their wake to trap the foe.

firepatternhurricanus.name: FIRE-PATTERN HURRICANUS
firepatternhurricanus.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit from your army has shot.
firepatternhurricanus.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, subtract 2 from the Move characteristic of models in that enemy unit, and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.
firepatternhurricanus.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, subtract 2 from the Move characteristic of models in that enemy unit, and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.
firepatternhurricanus.flavour: Emptying the magazines of their weapons in an indiscriminate hail of fire, the Scions create a zone of lethality that foes will struggle to advance into.
